## 改变与原因 / Change and rationale

说明具体问题、相关 Issue，以及这次修改后的行为或表述。 / Describe the problem, related issue and resulting behavior or wording.

## 证据与验证 / Evidence and validation

记录实际做过的检查和局限。文档检查不表示模型、构建、安装或语义验收通过。 / Record checks actually performed and their limits; documentation checks do not establish model, build, installation or semantic acceptance.

## 范围 / Scope

- [ ] 只包含相关且可公开的文件；没有密钥、客户资料、个人运行历史或私有工程源码。 / Relevant public material only; no credentials, customer data, personal runtime history or private implementation source.
- [ ] 保留冻结证据和材料许可；新增案例或词条注明来源与可公开依据。 / Frozen evidence and usage terms retained; sources and sharing basis identified for new cases or terms.
